subject: ela

sections.scope_note: Arizona standards deferred. This crosswalk covers Florida B.E.S.T. ELA (2025), Grade 7, and IB MYP language and literature only. Rows are suggested (Label C). No ELA.7.F or ELA.7.C.1.1 exists in the Florida grade-7 file.

rows.topic_domain: Literary text - setting, theme, narrators, and poetic form
ib_framework_elements: MYP language and literature: criterion A Analysing
MYP global context: personal and cultural expression
rows.key_differences: Florida asks how setting affects character and plot, how two or more themes develop, how unreliable narrators or point of view shift, and how poetic forms affect meaning and style. MYP analysing is broader and does not name those forms or the unreliable narrator.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: In a language and literature inquiry, analyse one scene for how the setting changes a character’s choice and whether the narrator is reliable.

rows.topic_domain: Informational text - purpose, central ideas, diction, and argument
ib_framework_elements: MYP language and literature: criterion A Analysing
rows.key_differences: Florida asks how sections or features convey purpose, how two or more central ideas develop, how diction and syntax achieve purpose, and how an argument’s reasoning works. MYP frames this as inquiry into texts, not that sequence.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use one informational text from the class inquiry. Name two central ideas and one sentence where word choice shows the author’s purpose.

rows.topic_domain: Across genres - figurative language, paraphrase, perspectives, and rhetorical devices
ib_framework_elements: MYP language and literature: six skill areas include reading and viewing
rows.key_differences: Florida asks how figurative language and allusions affect tone and meaning, requires paraphrase, compares authors with differing perspectives, and asks students to explain rhetorical devices. The public MYP pages do not list those devices.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Paraphrase a short passage, then name one figurative example and one rhetorical device without treating that pair as an MYP criterion.

rows.topic_domain: Writing - narratives, claims with a counterclaim, and expository texts
ib_framework_elements: MYP language and literature: criterion C Producing text
MYP global context: personal and cultural expression
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies narrative techniques, a claim that acknowledges at least one counterclaim, multi-source expository structure, and revision with adult and peer feedback. There is no ELA.7.C.1.1 in this grade. MYP producing text does not set those product rules.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Produce one claim for an inquiry audience, acknowledge one counterclaim, and revise using one piece of peer feedback.

ib_framework_elements: MYP language and literature: speaking and presenting
rows.key_differences: Florida requires a logical sequence that emphasizes key points supporting a central idea. Public ATL text names communication skills without those delivery details.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Present one inquiry finding aloud in a planned order, and have a partner name the central idea they heard.

ib_framework_elements: MYP language and literature: criterion D Using language
rows.key_differences: The Florida benchmark is grade-level grammar, punctuation, capitalization, and spelling. The clarification lists colons, modifiers, ellipses, hyphens, and sentence variety. Those skills are not on the public MYP pages. Criterion D is only a title here; its 1-8 descriptors were not copied.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Edit the inquiry writing for the conventions the class has been taught, without treating that list as an MYP criterion.

rows.key_differences: Florida requires multiple reliable and valid sources, further questions, diverse digital media that build cohesion, and digital tools to produce and share writing. MYP research skills are broader and do not set that reliability rule.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Answer one inquiry question from at least two sources the class judges reliable, and add one digital element that connects ideas rather than decorating them.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies academic vocabulary, Greek and Latin roots and affixes, and connotative as well as denotative meaning. The public MYP pages do not list those strategies.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Choose a few inquiry words, test one meaning with a root or affix, and use the word in speaking or writing.

version_notes: 2026-10-03: Grade 7 FL↔IB crosswalk for MYP, not PYP. Arizona left empty (deferred). Rows are suggested alignments (Label C). Florida IDs are from the grade 7 drafts. IB elements are public MYP framework text or criterion titles from the linked subject brief. No IB learning outcomes and no 1-8 criterion descriptors were invented.
